# StackHK - AI Tool Reviews
> Hong Kong's premier AI tool review platform. We test, compare, and recommend the best AI products.

## Core Information
- Founded: 2025
- Location: Hong Kong
- Coverage: AI tools across Writing, Coding, Productivity, Image, Audio, Business
- Methodology: Each tool tested for 2-4 weeks with standardized scoring (Features 30%, Ease of Use 20%, Performance 25%, Value 15%, Support 10%)
- Policy: No sponsored reviews. Affiliate links disclosed per FTC guidelines.

## Site Structure

### Primary Pages
- Home: https://www.StackHK.com/ — Latest reviews, featured comparisons, deals
- All Reviews: https://www.StackHK.com/reviews.html — Complete review index with scores
- Comparison Tool: https://www.StackHK.com/compare.html — Head-to-head AI tool comparisons
- Deals: https://www.StackHK.com/deals.html — Active coupons and discounts
- Categories: https://www.StackHK.com/categories.html — Browse by tool category
- Weekly Digest: https://www.StackHK.com/weekly.html — Newsletter archive
